home.name: Fede Longhi
home.headline: Senior software engineer.
home.tagline: 10 years designing and shipping software solutions across industries. Strong in Apex/LWC, integrations, and architecture — plus mentoring and hiring. Side projects in hardware/IoT (Mimir) and product (Pelambres 3D).

experience.description: Senior engineering on Salesforce-driven delivery for global clients.
bullets: Design and ship Salesforce platform features with a focus on clean architecture and maintainable Apex/Lightning code.
Partner with product and delivery teams to turn business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Apply AI-assisted workflows (prompting, agents, and coding copilots) to speed up design, implementation, and review.
Mentor teammates on Salesforce best practices and support high-quality engineering standards.

experience.description: Full-stack Salesforce development for a US-based software company.
bullets: Built features to automate fulfillment processes end-to-end on Salesforce.
Delivered technical improvements across Sales Cloud to raise reliability and developer velocity.
Ran technical interviews and helped grow the engineering hiring pipeline.

experience.description: Technical leadership and hands-on delivery at a Salesforce Summit consulting partner.
bullets: Led multiple projects as technical lead — guiding best practices, reviewing designs, and unblocking the team.
Drove architectural improvements and new features across Sales and Service Cloud implementations.
Implemented Einstein Bot with Knowledge Base, CRM Analytics event monitoring (incl. Azure integration), and custom LWC insights feeds.
Built and improved integrations using REST, SOAP, and Bulk API; delivered frontend with LWC, Aura, and Visualforce.
Developed processes for a custom CPQ application within Salesforce for a health insurance client; worked with Vlocity on multi-cloud rollouts.

projects.name: Mimir
projects.description: Hydroponic automation platform developed as the professional practice project for Computer Engineering (Ingeniería Informática).
projects.details: The system is built around a central engine written in Go, a React frontend for operating and visualizing the platform, and ESP32 devices programmed in C++ to drive sensors and run hardware tests in the growing setup.
highlights: Developed within the Computer Engineering professional practice framework
Go engine as the core of the system
React frontend for the platform UI
ESP32 + C++ for sensor control and hardware testing

projects.name: Pelambres 3D
projects.description: Professional 3D printing platform for rapid prototyping, custom parts, and on-demand fabrication — based in Martínez, Buenos Aires.
projects.details: The site is a Next.js app (App Router) deployed on Vercel, with a React UI and Tailwind CSS. It covers the full client journey: portfolio and services, quote requests with 3D file uploads (STL, OBJ, 3MF…), order tracking, a print guide, FAQ, courses, and maker tools like a cost calculator and quote generator.
highlights: Public site + quote flow with multi-file uploads
Client tools: cost calculator and quote generator
Order follow-up, courses, print guide, and FAQ

projects.description: Plataforma de automatización hidropónica desarrollada en el marco del trabajo profesional de Ingeniería Informática.

projects.name: Pelambres 3D
projects.description: Plataforma de impresión 3D profesional para prototipado rápido, piezas a medida y fabricación on-demand — en Martínez, Buenos Aires.
projects.details: La plataforma está hecha con Next.js (App Router) y desplegada en Vercel, con UI en React y estilos en Tailwind CSS. Cubre el recorrido del cliente: portfolio y servicios, solicitud de presupuesto con carga de archivos 3D (STL, OBJ, 3MF…), seguimiento de pedidos, guía de impresión, FAQ, cursos, y herramientas maker como calculadora de costos y generador de presupuestos.
highlights: Sitio público + flujo de cotización con carga de archivos
Herramientas: calculadora de costos y generador de presupuestos
Seguimiento de pedidos, cursos, guía de impresión y FAQ
